agent.welcome:
Hi, I am the scene assistant.

I can adjust the scene with natural language:
· "Add two actors, red and blue, at center and right"
· "Push the camera from wide to actor A"
· "Set duration to 15s"

⚠ The agent is still under development — currently just an input box. After LLM integration, I will actually make changes.
